# forgebase_queue_topic (Data Source)

Looks up a queue topic by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_queue_topic" "orders" {
  name = "orders"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Topic name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `created_by` (String) Creator.
- `dedup_window_ms` (Number) Deduplication window in milliseconds.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Unused in data sources.
- `id` (String) The topic name.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `max_message_bytes` (Number) Largest message in bytes.
- `retention_bytes` (Number) Size cap in bytes, if any.
- `retention_ms` (Number) Retention in milliseconds.
- `schema` (String) Message JSON Schema, if any.
- `source` (Attributes) Record source, if the topic is fed by a collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.
